decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 3, the title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: the gittith: an instrument or tune, perhaps from Gath
decisions.reason: The word (gittit) is found in the titles of Psalms 8, 81 and 84. It may be an instrument or tune from the city of Gath, or be linked with the word for a winepress (gat). Its sense is no longer known.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: "la guittith" kept as a name, spelled with "gu"
decisions.reason: Whether the word names an instrument or a tune, perhaps from Gath, is not known (m3), so French keeps the name as the English does. "Gu" keeps the hard g of the Hebrew in French spelling.

decisions.choice: "gitithi" kept as a name at every level
decisions.reason: Whether the gittith was an instrument or a tune is not known, though it may be linked with the town of Gath (m3). Swahili keeps the word, as the English does, and Readable says only that it names a way of playing.

decisions.choice: la guitit
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gittith names an instrument or a tune, perhaps one from the town of Gath; its meaning is not certain. Spanish keeps the word at every level, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Ghít-tít" kept as a name, with "theo [điệu]"
decisions.reason: The word may name an instrument or a tune, perhaps one from the town of Gath (see the meaning decision); since no one knows, every level keeps it as a name, as the English does. "điệu" (tune) is the most neutral word to hang it on, bracketed at Literal.

decisions.choice: "깃딧" kept as a name at every level
decisions.reason: The word may name an instrument or a tune, perhaps from Gath (meaning decision m3); its sense is lost, so Korean keeps it as a name, as the English does.

decisions.choice: a gitite (L, B); "Gitite" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (Psalms 8, 81, 84): the term, whose sense is unknown (m3), is kept in a Portuguese spelling like "seminite" (6:1); Readable names it as a tune, as the English does.

decisions.choice: on the gittith as "በጊቲት" (L, B), "«ጊቲት» በሚባለው ስልት" (R), as the heading table
decisions.reason: The word may be an instrument or a tune from Gath (meaning decision m3); it is kept as a name.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this psalm.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "गित्तीत", kept as a name
decisions.reason: The gittith may be an instrument or a tune, perhaps from Gath (meaning m3); the English keeps it as a name at every level, and so does the Hindi, in the form the poetry note gives.

decisions.choice: на гиттите (L, B); на «гиттите» (R)
decisions.reason: Gittith is an instrument or a tune, perhaps from Gath (m3); its sense is not known, so every level keeps the word as the Psalms terms note gives it, and Readable marks it as a name in quotation marks, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 'al-haggittit "ギティトに合わせて" (L, B), "「ギティト」に合わせる" (R, in quotation marks as the English Readable); tune and instrument names follow the English level in this way through the Psalter
alternatives: ガトの竪琴に合わせて
decisions.reason: The word may name an instrument or tune from Gath (m3); it is transliterated, and Readable marks it as a name as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: YHWH our Lord, how majestic [is] your name in all the earth, you who set your splendor above the heavens!

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, our Lord, how majestic [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name in all the earth, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who have set {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} splendor above the heavens!
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, our Lord, how glorious is {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name across the whole earth! Your splendor reaches higher than the heavens.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, our Lord, how great {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name is everywhere on earth! Your glory shines even above the sky.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, notre Seigneur, qu’il est majestueux, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, sur toute la terre, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as placé {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} splendeur au-dessus des cieux !

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Bwana wetu, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ni adhimu kama nini katika dunia yote, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyeweka fahari {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} juu ya mbingu!
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Bwana wetu, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lina utukufu ulioje duniani kote! Fahari {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} inafika juu kuliko mbingu.

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Господь наш, как могущественно {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя на всей земле, \q {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, кто поставил своё великолепие над небесами!
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Господь наш, как славно {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя по всей земле! \q Твоё великолепие выше небес.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Господь наш, как велико {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя повсюду на земле! \q Твоя слава сияет даже выше неба.

uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, наш Господи, яке велике {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя всюди на землі! \q Твоя слава сяє навіть понад небом.

decisions.choice: LORD, our Lord: the name and the title together
decisions.reason: The divine name YHWH is followed by the title "our Lord" ('adonenu), master and ruler. The people speak of the LORD as the one they serve.

decisions.choice: majestic: mighty and splendid
decisions.reason: The word ('addir) describes what is mighty and splendid, like great waters (Psalm 93:4) or a powerful king.

decisions.choice: your name: the LORD as he is known
decisions.reason: The name stands for God himself, as he has made himself known (5:12). His name is great wherever he is known on earth.

decisions.choice: you who set your splendor: hard to construe
alternatives: whose splendor is told above the heavens
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words (asher tenah) are unusual: "which, set!". They are most often read as "you who have set your splendor above the heavens"; some take the verb from a word for telling or praising, "your splendor is praised above the heavens". The sense is that God's splendor is higher than the heavens.

decisions.choice: splendor: royal majesty
decisions.reason: Splendor (hod) is the majesty of a king (1 Chronicles 29:25).

decisions.choice: glorious
decisions.reason: Balanced says "glorious" for the might and splendor of the word (m2); Literal keeps "majestic".

decisions.choice: "Chúa của chúng con" for "our Lord"
decisions.reason: The singer speaks to God for all his people, so he says "chúng con", as believers do in prayer (see 4:7); "Chúa" without capitals is the title Adonai, beside "CHÚA" for the name.

decisions.choice: nosso Senhor; quão grandioso (L); como é glorioso (B); como ... é grande (R)
decisions.reason: The opening and closing line (verse 10) is drafted from the Hebrew: the title 'adonenu is "nosso Senhor" (m1), with "Senhor" not in capitals, and 'addir, mighty and splendid (m2), is "grandioso" at Literal, "glorioso" at Balanced as the English, and "grande" at Readable, so that the line does not repeat the wording of a familiar Portuguese version.

decisions.choice: "LORD, our Lord" as "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጌታችን ሆይ": the name in its span, the title (ʾadon) as "ጌታችን"; majestic as "ግሩም" (L), "የከበረ" (B), "ታላቅ" (R)
decisions.reason: The name and the title stand side by side (meaning decision m1), so both are kept; verse 10 repeats the line word for word at each level.

decisions.choice: "हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारे प्रभु"
alternatives: "हे प्रभु, हमारे प्रभु" with no span
decisions.reason: The name and the title stand side by side (meaning m1), and both are "प्रभु" by default; only the name carries the divine_name span, so with the setting on the verse reads "हे याहवे, हमारे प्रभु" and the difference shows (see 1:1). The refrain of verse 10 is the same.

decisions.choice: "प्रतापी" (L), "महिमामय" (B), "महान" (R); "वैभव"
decisions.reason: The adjective means mighty and splendid (meaning m2) and the noun royal majesty (meaning m5); the Hindi follows the English level's word at each level.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Господь наш; как могущественно (L), как славно (B), как велико (R)
decisions.reason: The name and the title stand together (m1): the vocative of the name in capitals with its setting, then "Господь наш" for Adonai, not "Боже". The adjective means mighty and splendid (m2); each level chooses its own word, as the English does, and the refrain in verse 10 repeats it.

decisions.choice: YHWH 'adonenu "DNよ、わたしたちの主よ" at every level: the name in its span, the title Adonai as plain 主
decisions.reason: m1: the name and the title side by side; with the default setting both read 主, and the reader's setting shows the name in the first.

decisions.choice: 'asher tenah hodekha "あなたは、その威光を天の上に置かれた" (L), as the English Literal reads the hard clause
decisions.reason: The construction is uncertain (m4); Literal takes it as a statement of what God has done, Balanced and Readable as the English do.

source.text: מִפִּ֤י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים׀וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] mouth of children and nursing infants you have founded strength because of your foes, to silence [the] enemy and [the] avenger.

en.L: From [the] mouth of children and nursing infants {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have founded strength because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} foes, to silence [the] enemy and [the] avenger.
en.B: Out of the mouths of children and babies at the breast {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have built a stronghold against {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} foes, to silence the enemy and the one bent on revenge.
en.R: You use the words of children and babies to make a strong wall against {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies. That is how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} stop the enemy who wants to get even.

fr.L: De [la] bouche des enfants et des nourrissons {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fondé une force à cause de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} adversaires, pour réduire au silence l’ennemi et le vengeur.
fr.B: Par la bouche des enfants et des bébés qu’on allaite, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as bâti une forteresse contre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} adversaires, pour faire taire l’ennemi et celui qui ne pense qu’à se venger.
fr.R: Tu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sers des paroles des enfants et des bébés pour bâtir un mur solide contre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis. C’est ainsi que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} arrêtes l’ennemi qui veut se venger.

sw.L: Kutoka kinywa cha watoto na wanyonyao umeweka msingi wa nguvu kwa sababu ya watesi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili kumnyamazisha adui na mlipiza kisasi.
sw.B: Kutoka vinywani mwa watoto na vichanga vinavyonyonya umejenga ngome dhidi ya watesi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ili kumnyamazisha adui na yule anayetaka kulipiza kisasi.
sw.R: Unatumia maneno ya watoto na vichanga kujenga ukuta imara dhidi ya adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. Hivyo ndivyo unavyomzuia adui anayetaka kulipiza kisasi.

es.L: De [la] boca de niños y de lactantes {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has fundado fortaleza a causa de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} adversarios, para hacer callar [al] enemigo y [al] vengativo.
es.B: De la boca de los niños y de los bebés de pecho {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has levantado una fortaleza contra {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} adversarios, para hacer callar al enemigo y al que busca venganza.
es.R: Tú usas las palabras de los niños y de los bebés para hacer un muro fuerte contra {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos. Así {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} detienes al enemigo que quiere vengarse.

vi.L: Từ miệng của trẻ con và trẻ còn bú, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập nên sức mạnh vì cớ các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để làm câm lặng kẻ thù và kẻ báo thù.
vi.B: Từ miệng trẻ thơ và em bé còn bú, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã xây nên một đồn lũy chống lại các kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để làm im tiếng kẻ thù và kẻ quyết tâm báo thù.
vi.R: Ngài dùng lời nói của trẻ con và em bé để dựng nên một bức tường vững chắc chống lại kẻ thù của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Như vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho kẻ thù muốn trả thù phải im lặng.

ko.L: 어린아이들과 젖먹이들의 입에서 주님께서 주님의 대적들 때문에 힘을 세우셨으니, 원수와 복수하는 자를 잠잠하게 하시려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 어린아이들과 젖먹이들의 입으로 주님의 대적들을 막을 요새를 세우셔서, 원수와 앙갚음하려는 자를 잠잠하게 하셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 어린아이들과 아기들의 말로 주님의 원수들을 막는 튼튼한 성벽을 쌓으십니다. 그렇게 하셔서 앙갚음하려는 원수를 막으십니다.

pt.L: Da boca de crianças pequenas e dos que ainda mamam {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} firmaste força por causa dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} adversários, para fazer calar [o] inimigo e [o] vingador.
pt.B: Da boca das criancinhas e dos bebês que ainda mamam {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} levantaste uma fortaleza contra os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} adversários, para fazer calar o inimigo e quem quer se vingar.
pt.R: Tu usas as palavras das criancinhas e dos bebês para fazer um muro forte contra os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos. É assim que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fazes parar o inimigo que quer se vingar.

am.L: ስለ ባላጋራዎችህ ከሕፃናትና ከሚጠቡት አፍ ብርታትን መሠረትህ፤ ጠላትንና ተበቃዩን ታስቆም ዘንድ።
am.B: ከትንንሽ ልጆችና ከሚጠቡ ሕፃናት አፍ በባላጋራዎችህ ላይ ምሽግን ሠራህ፤ ጠላትንና በቀል የሚሻውን ዝም ታሰኝ ዘንድ።
am.R: በትንንሽ ልጆችና በሕፃናት ቃል ጠላቶችህን የሚከላከል ብርቱ ቅጥር ትሠራለህ። በዚህም ሊበቀል የሚፈልገውን ጠላት ታስቆማለህ።

hi.L: बालकों और दूध पीते [बच्चों] के मुँह से तूने अपने बैरियों के कारण सामर्थ्य की नींव डाली है, \q ताकि शत्रु और बदला लेनेवाले को चुप करा दे।
hi.B: छोटे बच्चों और दूध पीते शिशुओं के मुँह से तूने अपने बैरियों के विरुद्ध एक गढ़ खड़ा किया है, \q ताकि शत्रु को और बदला लेने पर तुले हुए को चुप करा दे।
hi.R: तू छोटे बच्चों और शिशुओं की बातों से अपने दुश्मनों के विरुद्ध एक मज़बूत दीवार बनाता है। \q इसी तरह तू उस दुश्मन को रोकता है \q जो बदला लेना चाहता है।

ru.L: Из уст младенцев и грудных [детей] {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} основал силу из-за {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} противников, \q чтобы заставить умолкнуть врага и мстителя.
ru.B: Из уст малых детей и грудных младенцев {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} воздвиг оплот против {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} противников, \q чтобы заставить замолчать врага и того, \q кто жаждет мести.
ru.R: Ты используешь слова, которые говорят малые дети и младенцы, \q чтобы построить крепкую стену против {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} врагов. \q Так {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} останавливаешь врага, который хочет отомстить.

ja.L: 幼子たちと乳飲み子たちの口から、あなたは、 \q あなたの仇のゆえに力を打ち立てられた、 \q 敵と復讐する者を黙らせるために。
ja.B: あなたは、幼子や乳飲み子の口によって、 \q あなたの仇に対する堅固な守りを築かれた。 \q 敵と、復讐を企てる者を黙らせるために。
ja.R: あなたは、小さな子どもや赤ちゃんの言葉を使って、敵に対する強い城壁を造られる。 \q そうやって、 \q 仕返しをしようとする敵の口を、ふさがれるのだ。

uk.L: З уст дітей і немовлят {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} заснував силу через {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} супротивників, \q щоб змусити замовкнути ворога й месника.
uk.B: З уст дітей і немовлят, що ссуть груди, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} збудував твердиню проти {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} супротивників, \q щоб змусити замовкнути ворога й того, \q хто прагне помсти.
uk.R: Словами дітей і немовлят {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зводиш міцну стіну проти {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} ворогів. \q Так {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зупиняєш ворога, \q що хоче помститися.

decisions.choice: strength: a stronghold, or praise
decisions.reason: The word ('oz) means strength, and "founded" suggests a stronghold built on the words of the weakest. The ancient Greek translation has "praise", and Jesus quotes it so when children praise him in the temple (Matthew 21:16).

decisions.choice: children and infants: God's power through the weak
decisions.reason: God answers the proud enemy not with an army but with the voices of children, so that the strength is plainly his (1 Corinthians 1:27).

decisions.choice: the avenger: the one who seeks revenge
decisions.reason: The word (mitnaqqem) describes someone set on taking revenge, an enemy who will not let go (44:17).

decisions.choice: Da boca de crianças pequenas e dos que ainda mamam (L); Da boca das criancinhas e dos bebês que ainda mamam (B); as criancinhas e os bebês (R); força, fortaleza
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes this line in Matthew 21:16, whose Portuguese reads "Da boca de crianças pequenas e dos que ainda mamam" (L) and "Da boca das criancinhas e dos bebês que ainda mamam" (B); the psalm keeps those words. Matthew follows the Greek "louvor"; the psalm keeps the Hebrew "força", which Balanced and Readable picture as a stronghold, as the English does (m1).

decisions.choice: "ከሕፃናትና ከሚጠቡት አፍ" (out of the mouth of infants and nursing babies) as Matthew 21:16 in the Amharic New Testament, then "ብርታትን መሠረትህ" (you have founded strength), following the Hebrew
alternatives: "ለራስህ ምስጋናን አዘጋጀህ" (you have prepared praise), as Matthew 21:16
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes the Greek translation, which has "praise" where the Hebrew has strength (meaning decision m1); the psalm follows the Hebrew and keeps the New Testament words where they agree.

decisions.choice: "बालकों और दूध पीते [बच्चों] के मुँह से" (L), "छोटे बच्चों और दूध पीते शिशुओं के मुँह से" (B), "छोटे बच्चों और शिशुओं" (R); "सामर्थ्य की नींव डाली", "गढ़"
alternatives: "तूने अपने लिए स्तुति तैयार की", as Matthew 21:16
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes this line in Matthew 21:16 from the Greek translation, and the Hindi keeps that verse's words for the children and infants at each level in this translation. Where Matthew has "praise", the Hebrew has strength, a stronghold (meaning m1), so the Hindi follows the Hebrew, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the words of Matthew 21:16 for the children; силу (L), оплот (B), крепкую стену (R) for the strength
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes the line in Matthew 21:16, so the children keep its wording at each level (младенцев и грудных [детей]; малых детей и грудных младенцев; малые дети и младенцы). Matthew follows the Greek translation, "praise"; the Hebrew word means strength, a stronghold (m1), and Russian translates the Hebrew.

decisions.choice: 'oz "力" (L), "堅固な守り" (B), "強い城壁" (R), with the Hebrew, not Matthew 21:16's 賛美; the opening "幼子たちと乳飲み子たちの口から" (L) as Matthew 21:16 L
decisions.reason: Jesus quotes the Greek translation, which reads "praise"; the meaning decision keeps the Hebrew "strength / stronghold" (footnote), so only the words that agree are shared with Matthew.

source.text: כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: When I see your heavens, [the] works of your fingers, [the] moon and [the] stars which you have set in place,

en.L: When I see {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} heavens, the work of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fingers, the moon and the stars which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have established,
en.B: When I look up at {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} heavens, which {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fingers made, at the moon and stars {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have fixed in their places,
en.R: I look up at the sky that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own hands. I see the moon and the stars that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} put in place.

fr.L: Quand je vois {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} cieux, l’ouvrage de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} doigts, la lune et les étoiles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as établies,
fr.B: Quand je regarde {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} cieux, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} doigts ont faits, la lune et les étoiles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fixées à leur place,
fr.R: Je regarde le ciel que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} propres mains. Je vois la lune et les étoiles que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as mises en place.

sw.L: Ninapoziona mbingu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, kazi ya vidole {{deity_pronoun:vyako|Vyako}}, mwezi na nyota ulizoziweka imara,
sw.B: Ninapozitazama mbingu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, zilizofanywa na vidole {{deity_pronoun:vyako|Vyako}}, mwezi na nyota ulizozikaza mahali pake,
sw.R: Ninatazama juu angani, ulilolifanya kwa mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mwenyewe. Ninaona mwezi na nyota ulizoziweka mahali pake.

es.L: Cuando veo {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} cielos, la obra de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} dedos, la luna y las estrellas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has establecido,
es.B: Cuando miro {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} cielos, hechos por {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} dedos, la luna y las estrellas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} fijaste en su lugar,
es.R: Miro el cielo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} hiciste con {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} propias manos. Veo la luna y las estrellas que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} pusiste en su lugar.

vi.L: Khi tôi nhìn các tầng trời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, công việc của các ngón tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã thiết lập,
vi.B: Khi tôi ngước nhìn các tầng trời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là công việc của các ngón tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhìn mặt trăng và các ngôi sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt vào chỗ của chúng,
vi.R: Tôi ngước nhìn bầu trời mà chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên. Tôi thấy mặt trăng và các ngôi sao mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt vào chỗ.

ko.L: 주님의 하늘, 주님의 손가락으로 하신 일을, 주님께서 세우신 달과 별들을 제가 볼 때,
ko.B: 주님의 손가락으로 지으신 하늘을, 주님께서 제자리에 두신 달과 별들을 제가 올려다볼 때,
ko.R: 저는 주님께서 손수 만드신 하늘을 올려다봅니다. 주님께서 제자리에 두신 달과 별들을 봅니다.

pt.L: Quando eu vejo os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} céus, trabalho dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} dedos, a lua e as estrelas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} firmaste,
pt.B: Quando olho para os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} céus, que os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} dedos fizeram, para a lua e as estrelas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fixaste nos seus lugares,
pt.R: Eu olho para o céu que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste com as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} próprias mãos. Vejo a lua e as estrelas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} puseste no lugar.

am.L: የጣቶችህን ሥራ ሰማያትህን፣ ያጸናሃቸውንም ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን ባየሁ ጊዜ፣
am.B: ጣቶችህ የሠሯቸውን ሰማያትህን፣ በስፍራቸውም ያኖርሃቸውን ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን ቀና ብዬ ስመለከት፣
am.R: በገዛ እጆችህ የሠራኸውን ሰማይ ቀና ብዬ እመለከታለሁ። በስፍራቸው ያኖርሃቸውን ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን አያለሁ።

hi.L: जब मैं तेरे आकाशमंडल को, तेरी उँगलियों के काम को, \q चंद्रमा और तारों को जिन्हें तूने स्थिर किया है, देखता हूँ,
hi.B: जब मैं तेरे आकाशमंडल को देखता हूँ, जिसे तेरी उँगलियों ने बनाया, \q और चंद्रमा और तारों को जिन्हें तूने उनके स्थान पर जमाया है,
hi.R: मैं ऊपर आकाश को देखता हूँ, जिसे तूने अपने ही हाथों से बनाया। \q मैं चाँद और तारों को देखता हूँ, जिन्हें तूने उनकी जगह पर रखा।

ru.L: Когда я вижу {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} небеса, дело {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} пальцев, \q луну и звёзды, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} утвердил,
ru.B: Когда я смотрю на {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} небеса, созданные {{deity_pronoun:твоими|Твоими}} пальцами, \q на луну и звёзды, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} закрепил на их местах,
ru.R: Я смотрю на небо, которое {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} создал своими руками. \q Я вижу луну и звёзды, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} поставил на место.

ja.L: あなたの天、あなたの指のわざ、 \q あなたが据えられた月と星を、わたしが見るとき、
ja.B: あなたの指が造られたあなたの天を、 \q あなたが据えられた月と星を、わたしが見上げるとき、
ja.R: わたしは、あなたがご自分の手で造られた空を見上げる。 \q あなたが置かれた月や星を見る。

uk.L: Коли я бачу {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} небеса, діло {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} пальців, \q місяць і зорі, які {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} утвердив,
uk.B: Коли я дивлюся на {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} небеса, що їх створили {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} пальці, \q на місяць і зорі, які {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} поставив на їхні місця,
uk.R: Я дивлюся вгору на небо, яке {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} створив {{deity_pronoun:твоїми|Твоїми}} власними руками. \q Я бачу місяць і зорі, які {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} поставив на місце.

decisions.choice: the work of your fingers: made with care and skill
decisions.reason: Fingers suggest fine, careful work (Exodus 31:18). The vast heavens are like delicate handiwork to God.

decisions.choice: When I see ...: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The sentence continues into verse 5 ("what is a human being ...?"), so this verse ends with a comma.

decisions.choice: the moon and the stars: the night sky
decisions.reason: The psalmist looks at the night sky; the sun is not named. In the ancient world many worshiped the moon and stars; here they are things God made (Genesis 1:16).

records.literal_gloss: what [is] man that you remember him, and a son of man that you visit him?

en.L: what [is] {{gender:a human|man}} that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} remember {{gender:them|him}}, and {{gender:a mortal|the son of man}} that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} visit {{gender:them|him}}?
en.B: what are {{gender:human beings|men}}, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep them in mind, mere mortals, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} look after them?
en.R: Who are we people, that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} even think about us? Why do {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} care about human beings at all?

fr.L: qu’[est] {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} souviennes de lui, et {{gender:un mortel|le fils de l’homme}}, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le visites ?
fr.B: que sont {{gender:les humains|les hommes}}, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} penses à eux, de simples mortels, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prennes soin d’eux ?
fr.R: Que sommes-nous, nous les humains, pour que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} penses à nous ? Pourquoi les êtres humains comptent-ils autant pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ?

sw.L: binadamu [ni] nini hata umkumbuke, na mwana wa Adamu hata umtembelee?
sw.B: wanadamu ni nini, hata uwakumbuke; watu wanaokufa, hata uwatunze?
sw.R: Sisi wanadamu ni nani, hata utufikirie? Kwa nini unawajali binadamu hata kidogo?

es.L: ¿qué [es] {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}} para que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} acuerdes de él, y {{gender:el mortal|el hijo del hombre}} para que lo visites?
es.B: ¿qué son {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} para que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} pienses en ellos, simples mortales, para que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} los cuides?
es.R: ¿Quiénes somos las personas, para que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} siquiera pienses en nosotros? ¿Por qué {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} preocupas por los seres humanos?

vi.L: thì loài người là gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ đến, và con của loài người là gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thăm viếng?
vi.B: thì con người là gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nhớ đến họ, người phàm là gì mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm sóc họ?
vi.R: Chúng con là ai mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại nghĩ đến chúng con? Sao {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại quan tâm đến loài người như thế?

ko.L: 사람이 무엇이기에 주님께서 그를 기억하시며, {{gender:인생이|사람의 아들이}} 무엇이기에 주님께서 그를 찾아오십니까?
ko.B: 사람이 무엇이기에 주님께서 마음에 두시며, 한낱 인생이 무엇이기에 주님께서 돌보십니까?
ko.R: 저희 사람이 무엇이기에 주님께서 저희를 생각해 주십니까? 사람이 무엇이기에 주님께서 이렇게 돌보아 주십니까?

pt.L: que [é] {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}}, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lembres dele, e {{gender:um mortal|o filho do homem}}, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cuides dele?
pt.B: que é {{gender:o ser humano|o homem}}, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lembres dele, ou {{gender:um simples mortal|o filho do homem}}, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cuides dele?
pt.R: Quem somos nós, seres humanos, para que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} penses em nós? Por que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cuidas de simples mortais como nós?

am.L: ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድን ነው? ትጎበኘውስ ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድን ነው?
am.B: ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድን ነው? ትጠብቀውስ ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድን ነው?
am.R: አንተ የምታስበው ሰው ምንድን ነው? አንተ የምትንከባከበው ሟች ሰው ምንድን ነው?

hi.L: तो मनुष्य क्या [है] कि तू उसे स्मरण करता है, \q और {{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य का पुत्र}} [क्या है] कि तू उसकी देखभाल करता है?
hi.B: तो मनुष्य क्या है कि तू उसे याद रखे, \q और {{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य का पुत्र}} क्या है कि तू उसकी देखभाल करे?
hi.R: तो हम मनुष्य क्या हैं कि तू हमारे बारे में सोचे भी? \q तू मनुष्यों की चिंता क्यों करता है?

ru.L: что такое человек, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} помнишь его, \q или сын человеческий, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} посещаешь его?
ru.B: что такое человек, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} помнишь о нём, \q или {{gender:смертный|сын человеческий}}, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} заботишься о нём?
ru.R: Что такое человек, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} думаешь о нём? \q Что такое {{gender:простой смертный|сын человеческий}}, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} заботишься о нём?

ja.L: 人とは何者なのか、あなたが彼を心に留めるとは。 \q また人の子とは何者なのか、あなたが彼を顧みるとは。
ja.B: 人とは何者なのか、あなたが心に留めるとは。 \q 人の子とは何者なのか、あなたが顧みるとは。
ja.R: 人間とは何者なのか、あなたが心にかけてくださるとは。 \q ただの人間にすぎない者が何者なのか、あなたが世話をしてくださるとは。

uk.L: що таке {{gender:людина|чоловік}}, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} памʼятаєш про {{gender:неї|нього}}, \q і {{gender:смертний|син людський}}, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} відвідуєш його?
uk.B: що таке {{gender:люди|чоловіки}}, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} думаєш про них, \q звичайні смертні, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} дбаєш про них?
uk.R: Хто ми, люди, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} взагалі думаєш про нас? \q Чому {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} піклуєшся про людей?

decisions.choice: man, son of man: a human being, weak and mortal
decisions.reason: Both words mean a human being. The first ('enosh) is often used for human weakness (9:21, 103:15); "son of man" (ben 'adam) means simply a member of the human race (Ezekiel 2:1; Numbers 23:19). Next to the heavens, human beings seem very small.

decisions.choice: remember, visit: think of with care, look after
decisions.reason: To remember (zakar) is to keep in mind with care; to visit (paqad) is to come to someone's aid (Genesis 21:1).

decisions.choice: son of man: applied to Jesus in Hebrews 2
decisions.reason: Hebrews 2:6-9 quotes verses 5-7 from the Greek translation and applies them to Jesus, the one human being who was made lower than the angels for a little while and is now crowned with glory. In the psalm the words are about humankind; Hebrews sees them fulfilled in him.

decisions.choice: a human, a mortal, them (with "man", "son of man", "him" as the alternatives)
decisions.reason: The words mean any human being (m1), so the gender setting gives inclusive wording by default and the traditional words, which Hebrews 2 quotes (m3), as the alternative.

decisions.choice: we people, human beings
decisions.reason: Readable speaks as one of the humans the psalm is about.

decisions.choice: spans on the nouns only: "l'être humain" / "les humains" with "l'homme" / "les hommes" as the alternative, "un mortel" with "le fils de l'homme"; "lui", "le", "eux" carry no span
decisions.reason: The words mean a human being, weak and mortal (m1). French has a choice only on the nouns; the pronouns that refer back to them are the same for both options, so they need no span, where English needs "them"/"him". The traditional "le fils de l'homme" is kept as the alternative because Hebrews 2 quotes this verse (m3).

decisions.choice: "mwana wa Adamu" (son of Adam) for ben adam at Literal; "watu wanaokufa" (mortal people) at Balanced
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "son of man" means a human being (m1). Swahili "Adamu" is both the first man and humankind, so Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase and the link with Hebrews 2 and the title "Mwana wa Adamu" (m3); Balanced says what it means. No gender setting is needed: "binadamu" and "wanadamu" already include everyone.

decisions.choice: {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}}; {{gender:el mortal|el hijo del hombre}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew means any human being, weak and mortal. As in the English, the default says so, and the traditional "el hombre" and "el hijo del hombre", the wording Hebrews 2 quotes, is the alternative. "Él" and "lo" after them stay as they are, since Spanish uses them for a person of either sex.

decisions.choice: "loài người", "con của loài người" (L); "con người", "người phàm", "họ" (B); no gender spans
alternatives: gender spans as in the English ("a human"/"man")
decisions.reason: The Vietnamese words for a human being already include men and women, so there is no second form for the gender setting. Literal keeps "con của loài người" for "son of man" so a reader can see the phrase Hebrews 2 applies to Jesus (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "Chúng con" for "we people" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable has the singer speak for all people, as the English Readable does, and in speaking to God Vietnamese says "chúng con".

decisions.choice: {{gender:인생이|사람의 아들이}} at Literal; "사람" and "인생" with no span elsewhere
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" (a human) is already inclusive, so it needs no span. For "son of man" Korean does have two wordings, "인생" (a mortal) and the word-for-word "사람의 아들", which also keeps the link to Hebrews 2 (meaning decision m3); Literal offers both, as the English does.

decisions.choice: que é o ser humano, para que tu te lembres dele (L, B); para que tu cuides dele; tu penses, tu cuidas (R)
alternatives: que é o homem, que dele te lembres
decisions.reason: Hebrews 2:6 quotes verses 5-7 (m3), and its Portuguese reads "Que é o ser humano, para que tu te lembres dele, ... para que tu cuides dele?" (with "o homem" as the gender alternative), with "um simples mortal" at Balanced; the psalm keeps those words and the gender setting, and says "cuides" for "visit" (m2), as Hebrews does. "Dele" agrees with both options, so it needs no span. Readable speaks as one of us, as the English Readable does, and keeps Hebrews' "penses" and "cuidas".

decisions.choice: The wording of Hebrews 2:6 in the Amharic New Testament: "ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድን ነው? ትጎበኘውስ ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድን ነው?" (L; B "ትጠብቀውስ"; R as Hebrews 2:6 Readable)
alternatives: plural forms, as the English Balanced "human beings ... them"
decisions.reason: The Greek of Hebrews agrees with the Hebrew here, so each level keeps the New Testament wording; the singular "ሰው" means humankind, as the Hebrew singular does.

decisions.choice: No gender spans in Amharic for "ሰው" and "የሰው ልጅ"
decisions.reason: "ሰው" and "የሰው ልጅ" (a human being) already include women and men; "የሰው ልጅ" here is not the title of Jesus but the Hebrew's "son of man", a mortal (meaning decision m1). The same holds for 8:6-7 and 9:20-21.

decisions.choice: the wording of Hebrews 2:6 ("मनुष्य क्या है कि तू उसे स्मरण करता है", "याद रखे", "देखभाल", "सोचे", "चिंता"), with "और" for the Hebrew "and"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 2:6 quotes this verse, and the Hindi keeps its wording at each level in this translation, with "और" where the Hebrew has "and". Readable speaks as one of the humans the psalm is about, as the English does, with the verbs of Hebrews 2:6 (Readable).

decisions.choice: "{{gender:मनुष्य की सन्तान|मनुष्य का पुत्र}}"; "मनुष्य" with no span
decisions.reason: The words mean any human being (meaning m1). Hindi "मनुष्य" already includes everyone, so it needs no span where the English has one; "son of man" takes the span Hebrews 2:6 (Balanced) has in this translation, with the traditional wording, which Hebrews applies to Jesus (meaning m3), as the alternative. The pronouns "उसे", "उसकी" in verses 5-7 are the same for a man or a woman.

decisions.choice: the wording of Hebrews 2:6 at each level, with its gender settings
alternatives: Кто мы, люди, что ты думаешь о нас? (R)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 2:6 quotes the verse and applies "son of man" to Jesus (m3), so Russian keeps its wording at each level, with "человек" (already inclusive, no setting) and the gender setting on "смертный" / "сын человеческий" where Hebrews has it. Readable keeps the third person of Hebrews rather than the English Readable's "we people".

decisions.choice: The verse as Hebrews 2:6 has it in Japanese at each level (L 人とは何者なのか、あなたが彼を心に留めるとは。また人の子とは何者なのか…; B without the pronouns; R 人間とは何者なのか…心にかけてくださるとは), in the plain style; ben-adam "人の子" (L, B)
alternatives: 人間とは何者なので、あなたは…
decisions.reason: The Greek of Hebrews 2:6 reads as the Hebrew, and m3 notes the use of "son of man" there; keeping the same Japanese lets the reader hear the quotation. Literal and Balanced keep Hebrews' plain verbs (心に留める, 顧みる) rather than the Psalter's respect forms, so the two places are word for word the same.

decisions.choice: No gender span: 人 / 人の子 and the pronoun 彼 (L, as Hebrews 2:6) or no pronoun (B)
decisions.reason: 人 and 人の子 already speak of a human being without narrowing to a man.

source.text: וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you made him lack a little from God, and [with] glory and majesty you crown him.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made {{gender:them|him}} lack a little from God, and with glory and majesty {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} crown {{gender:them|him}}.
en.B: You made them only a little less than God and set a crown of glory and honor on them.
en.R: You made people almost like God. You gave them a crown of glory and honor.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as fait de peu moindre que Dieu, et de gloire et de majesté {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le couronnes.
fr.B: Tu as fait d’eux des êtres à peine moins grands que Dieu, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les as couronnés de gloire et d’honneur.
fr.R: Tu as fait les humains presque semblables à Dieu. Tu leur as donné une couronne de gloire et d’honneur.

sw.L: Nawe umemfanya apungue kidogo kuliko Mungu, na kwa utukufu na fahari unamvika taji.
sw.B: Uliwafanya wawe chini kidogo tu ya Mungu, ukawavika taji ya utukufu na heshima.
sw.R: Uliwafanya watu karibu kuwa kama Mungu. Uliwapa taji ya utukufu na heshima.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo has hecho un poco menor que Dios, y de gloria y majestad lo coronas.
es.B: Tú los hiciste solo un poco menores que Dios y les pusiste una corona de gloria y honra.
es.R: Tú hiciste a las personas casi como Dios. Les diste una corona de gloria y honra.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho người kém Đức Chúa Trời một chút, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đội cho người vinh quang và sự oai nghiêm.
vi.B: Ngài làm cho họ chỉ kém Đức Chúa Trời một chút, và đội cho họ mão miện vinh quang và danh dự.
vi.R: Ngài làm cho loài người gần giống như Đức Chúa Trời. Ngài ban cho họ mão miện vinh quang và danh dự.

ko.L: 주님께서 그를 하나님보다 조금 모자라게 하시고, 영광과 위엄으로 그에게 관을 씌우십니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 사람을 하나님보다 조금 못하게 지으시고, 영광과 존귀의 관을 씌워 주셨습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 사람을 하나님과 거의 같게 만드셨습니다. 그들에게 영광과 존귀의 관을 씌워 주셨습니다.

pt.L: E {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o fizeste um pouco menor que Deus, e de glória e de majestade {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o coroaste.
pt.B: Tu o puseste só um pouco abaixo de Deus; de glória e de honra {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} o coroaste.
pt.R: Tu fizeste as pessoas quase iguais a Deus. Tu deste a elas glória e honra, como uma coroa.

am.L: ከአምላክ ጥቂት አሳነስከው፤ በክብርና በሞገስም አቀዳጀኸው።
am.B: ከአምላክ ጥቂት ብቻ አሳነስከው፤ በክብርና በሞገስም አቀዳጀኸው።
am.R: ከአምላክ ጥቂት ብቻ ዝቅ አደረግኸው። ክብርንና ሞገስን እንደ ዘውድ ሰጠኸው።

hi.L: और तूने उसे परमेश्वर से थोड़ा ही कम किया, \q और महिमा और प्रताप का मुकुट उसे पहनाया।
hi.B: तूने उसे परमेश्वर से थोड़ा ही कम बनाया, \q और उसे महिमा और आदर का मुकुट पहनाया।
hi.R: तूने मनुष्य को लगभग परमेश्वर जैसा बनाया। \q तूने उसे महिमा और आदर का मुकुट दिया।

ru.L: И {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал его немногим ниже Бога, \q и славой и величием {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} венчаешь его.
ru.B: Ты сделал его немного ниже Бога, \q славой и честью {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} увенчал его.
ru.R: Ты сделал его почти равным Богу. \q Ты дал ему славу и честь, как венец.

ja.L: あなたは彼を、神よりわずかに劣る者とし、 \q 栄光と威光の冠を彼にかぶらせる。
ja.B: あなたは人を、神よりほんの少し低い者とされ、 \q 栄光と誉れの冠をかぶらせてくださった。

uk.L: І {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} зробив {{gender:її трохи меншою|його трохи меншим}} від Бога, \q і славою та величчю {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вінчаєш {{gender:її|його}}.

decisions.choice: God: God, or heavenly beings
decisions.reason: The word ('elohim) usually means God, but it can also mean heavenly beings (compare Psalm 82:1, 6). The ancient Greek translation has "angels", and Hebrews 2:7 quotes it so. Humans were made in God's image (Genesis 1:26-27), only a little below him.

decisions.choice: crown with glory and majesty: give royal honor
decisions.reason: Glory and majesty are the honors of a king (21:6). God has given human beings a royal place in creation, as verse 7 goes on to say.

decisions.choice: honor
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "honor" for the word (hadar); Literal keeps "majesty".

decisions.choice: them, people
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, the words mean humankind; Balanced and Readable say "them".

decisions.choice: um pouco menor que Deus (L); um pouco abaixo de Deus (B); o coroaste; glória e honra, como uma coroa (R)
alternatives: um pouco menor que os anjos
decisions.reason: Hebrews 2:7 quotes this verse from the Greek, "um pouco menor que [os] anjos; de glória e de honra tu o coroaste" (L), "Tu o puseste um pouco abaixo dos anjos" (B), "glória e honra, como uma coroa" (R). The psalm keeps those words but follows the Hebrew "Deus" (m1). The pronoun "o" stands for "o ser humano" (verse 5) and fits both options of the gender setting, so Literal has no span where the English has "them|him".

decisions.choice: "ከአምላክ ጥቂት አሳነስከው" (you made him a little less than God), following the Hebrew; "በክብርና በሞገስ አቀዳጀኸው" as Hebrews 2:7
alternatives: "ከመላእክት ጥቂት አሳነስከው" (than the angels), as Hebrews 2:7
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has ʾelohim, God or heavenly beings (meaning decision m1); the Greek translation, which Hebrews quotes, says "angels". "አምላክ" (God, a god) leaves room for both senses of the Hebrew. The crowning keeps the New Testament words.

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर से थोड़ा ही कम"; "महिमा और ... मुकुट पहनाया"
alternatives: "स्वर्गदूतों से थोड़ा ही नीचे", as Hebrews 2:7
decisions.reason: Hebrews 2:7 quotes this verse from the Greek translation, which has "angels"; the Hebrew word (elohim) can mean God or heavenly beings (meaning m1), and the English takes it as God, so the Hindi does too. The crowning keeps the wording of Hebrews 2:7 in this translation ("प्रताप" at Literal for the Hebrew's "majesty").

decisions.choice: Бога, where Hebrews 2:7 has "ангелов"; the rest in the words of Hebrews 2:7 (славой и честью ... увенчал; дал ему славу и честь, как венец)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 2:7 follows the Greek translation, "angels"; the Hebrew has Elohim, God or heavenly beings (m1), and Russian translates it as "Бог", as the English does. Balanced and Readable keep Hebrews' words for the crown; Literal says "величием" for hadar, as the English Literal keeps "majesty".

decisions.choice: me'elohim "神より", not Hebrews 2:7's "天使たちよりも"; "栄光と誉れの冠をかぶらせ" (B) as Hebrews 2:7 B
decisions.reason: Hebrews quotes the Greek translation ("angels"); the meaning decision keeps "God" with a footnote on heavenly beings, so the Japanese follows the Hebrew there and shares Hebrews' words only for the crown, where they agree.

decisions.choice: rule over the works of your hands: the command of Genesis 1
decisions.reason: God made humankind to rule over the creatures (Genesis 1:26-28). Paul and Hebrews quote "he put all things under his feet" of Christ (1 Corinthians 15:27; Ephesians 1:22; Hebrews 2:8).

decisions.choice: under his feet: in his power
decisions.reason: To put something under someone's feet is to give him authority over it (Psalm 110:1).

decisions.choice: under his feet: the list follows
decisions.reason: Verses 8-9 list what is under human rule, so this verse ends with a colon.

decisions.choice: todas as coisas tu puseste debaixo dos pés dele (L); tu puseste tudo debaixo dos pés dele (B)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 2:8 and 1 Corinthians 15:27 quote this line (m1); Hebrews' Portuguese reads "todas as coisas tu sujeitaste debaixo dos pés dele" (L) and "Tu puseste tudo debaixo dos pés dele" (R). The psalm keeps "debaixo dos pés dele" and the Hebrew verb "puseste". As in verses 5-6, "o" and "dele" need no gender span.

decisions.choice: "ሁሉን ከእግሮቹ በታች አስገዛህለት" as Hebrews 2:8
decisions.reason: The Greek of Hebrews 2:8 agrees with the Hebrew here.

decisions.choice: "सब कुछ उसके पाँवों के नीचे कर दिया"
decisions.reason: The wording of Hebrews 2:8 in this translation; Readable says what "under his feet" means (meaning m2), as the English does.

decisions.choice: the words of Hebrews 2:8 for "all things under his feet"
decisions.reason: Hebrews 2:8 quotes the line; Russian keeps its wording at each level (всё ты подчинил под его ноги; всё ты положил под его ноги; Ты положил всё под его ноги). As in verse 5, "его" is the human being, singular as in Hebrews, where the English Balanced and Readable say "them".

decisions.choice: shattah "置かれた", as Ephesians 1:22 B and 1 Corinthians 15:27 (足の下に置く), not Hebrews 2:8's 服従させた / 従わせた
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "put"; Ephesians' Japanese already has that verb, while Hebrews follows the Greek "subject".

ja.L: 空の鳥と海の魚、 \q 海の道を通り行くものを。
ja.B: 空の鳥も海の魚も、 \q 海の道を行き交うすべてのものも。
ja.R: 空の鳥も、海の魚も、 \q 海を泳ぐすべての生き物も。

uk.L: птахів небесних і риб морських, усе, \q що проходить стежками морів.
uk.B: птахів у повітрі й риб у морі, і все, \q що мандрує морськими стежками.
uk.R: птахів у небі, риб у морі й усіх істот, \q що пливуть океаном.

decisions.choice: passing along the paths of the seas: every sea creature
decisions.reason: The phrase may describe the fish or add all other creatures that move through the sea. The list follows the order of Genesis 1: land, sky, sea.

decisions.choice: every creature that swims through the ocean
alternatives: whatever passes along the paths of the seas
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the picture describes (m1).

records.literal_gloss: YHWH our Lord, how majestic [is] your name in all the earth!

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, our Lord, how majestic [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name in all the earth!
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, our Lord, how glorious is {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name across the whole earth!
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, our Lord, how great {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name is everywhere on earth!

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, notre Seigneur, qu’il est majestueux, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, sur toute la terre !
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, notre Seigneur, que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom est glorieux par toute la terre !
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, notre Seigneur, comme {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom est grand partout sur la terre !

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Bwana wetu, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ni adhimu kama nini katika dunia yote!
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Bwana wetu, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lina utukufu ulioje duniani kote!
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Bwana wetu, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ni kuu mno kila mahali duniani!

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Señor nuestro, ¡qué majestuoso [es] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre en toda la tierra!
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Señor nuestro, ¡cuánta gloria tiene {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre en la tierra entera!
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Señor nuestro, ¡qué grande es {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre en todo el mundo!

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Chúa của chúng con, danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} oai nghiêm biết bao trên khắp đất!
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Chúa của chúng con, danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vinh hiển biết bao trên khắp đất!
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Chúa của chúng con, danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại biết bao ở khắp mọi nơi trên đất!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희의 주님, 온 땅에 주님의 이름이 얼마나 위엄 있습니까!
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희의 주님, 온 땅에 주님의 이름이 얼마나 영광스럽습니까!
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희의 주님, 주님의 이름이 온 세상 어디에서나 얼마나 위대합니까!

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Senhor, quão grandioso [é] o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome em toda a terra!
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Senhor, como é glorioso o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome por toda a terra!
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Senhor, como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome é grande em todo lugar da terra!

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጌታችን ሆይ፣ ስምህ በምድር ሁሉ ላይ እንዴት ግሩም ነው!
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጌታችን ሆይ፣ ስምህ በምድር ሁሉ ምንኛ የከበረ ነው!
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ጌታችን ሆይ፣ ስምህ በምድር በሁሉም ስፍራ እንዴት ታላቅ ነው!

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारे प्रभु, \q सारी पृथ्वी पर तेरा नाम कितना प्रतापी [है]!
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारे प्रभु, \q सारी पृथ्वी पर तेरा नाम कितना महिमामय है!
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हमारे प्रभु, \q सारी धरती पर तेरा नाम कितना महान है!

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Господь наш, \q как могущественно {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя на всей земле!
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Господь наш, \q как славно {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя по всей земле!
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Господь наш, \q как велико {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя повсюду на земле!

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしたちの主よ、 \q あなたの名は全地で、なんと威厳に満ちていることか！
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしたちの主よ、 \q あなたの名は、全地にわたって、なんと栄光に満ちていることか！
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしたちの主よ、 \q あなたの名は、世界中で、なんとすばらしいことか！

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, наш Господи, \q яке величне {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя по всій землі!
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, наш Господи, \q яке славне {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя по всій землі!
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, наш Господи, \q яке велике {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя всюди на землі!

decisions.choice: LORD, our Lord: the name and the title together
decisions.reason: The divine name YHWH is followed by the title "our Lord" ('adonenu), master and ruler. The people speak of the LORD as the one they serve.

decisions.choice: majestic: mighty and splendid
decisions.reason: The word ('addir) describes what is mighty and splendid, like great waters (Psalm 93:4) or a powerful king.

decisions.choice: your name: the LORD as he is known
decisions.reason: The name stands for God himself, as he has made himself known (5:12). His name is great wherever he is known on earth.

decisions.choice: the refrain: the psalm ends as it began
decisions.reason: The first line of verse 2 returns, framing the whole psalm: the praise of human beings in the middle is held inside the praise of God.

decisions.choice: glorious
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

decisions.choice: The refrain repeats 8:2's first sentence word for word at each level
decisions.reason: The psalm ends as it began (m4), and the Japanese shows it by repeating the same words.
